verdict.rationale: There is evidence of programmatic access via the Codex CLI/SDK for coding automation and CI jobs, and a security-scan CLI, but nothing shows that the broad set of UI-only capabilities (Canvas/image editing, Computer Use, Voice, Work desktop automations, Sites, MCP-in-chat, memories, scheduled tasks) are exposed through a general ChatGPT API with parity to the UI. A probe for an OpenAPI/swagger spec on the docs site also returned 404s, reinforcing the lack of a documented full API surface. missing for 10: documented API endpoints mirroring Canvas/image tools, Computer Use, Voice, Work automations, Sites, and MCP-in-chat; independent confirmation of API-UI feature parity.
